idea-plugin.name: JetTreeMark
idea-plugin.description:
JetTreeMark is a plugin for IntelliJ IDEA that enhances project collaboration by generating a clean, copiable tree view of your folder structure. The intuitive features save time and improve your workflow.

Key Features

  • Automatically generate folder and file hierarchy views
  • Copy the generated tree view to your clipboard
  • Customize inclusions and exclusions for files/folders in the view
  • Support for multiple tabs to compare folder structures
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.0

  • Improved performance and memory safety for very large trees.
  • Use IDE VCS ignore status and lazily load ignored directories.
  • Add streamed tree export for output too large for the clipboard.
